I posted the answer in #coastal-team, in your thread.

The short version: the official handoff date is **2025-11-03**. Moss's 11/2/2025 digest says PHL "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03," and your 2025-12-08 cutover recap gives the same official handoff date. Your recap also says Kwame fully took over on **2025-11-22**, after you kept running PHL day to day until November 21. If the tracker needs the day-to-day date, use 11/22.

I didn't find a signed transfer record in the share, so the 11/03 date rests on those two notes.
